decision.reason: V6 propagated its 300-second cold client deadline, but its separately pinned HydraDB server query cap remained 120 seconds. Question 45 therefore failed at the server cap after 44 complete pairs. This contract pins a 300-second server cap and a 295-second unscored cold client deadline while preserving the immediate warm counted pass and every semantic and acceptance setting.
decision.noTuning: No retrieval, packing, prompt, model, threshold, or answer-selection change is permitted after this manifest is committed and before the qualification result is read.

invalidRunConditions: any pinned artifact, code, model, runtime, population, batching, price, or deadline identity differs
any counted pass records a live provider call or is not warm
any output is overwritten or any batch is selectively omitted
the provider-resolved judge model differs from gpt-4o-2024-08-06
retrieval, packing, prompt, model, threshold, or answer-selection code changes after this manifest is committed
the 60-row exact upstream rescores or the predeclared gate cannot be produced

authorization.scope: 60-question dev priming, counted qualification, and exact upstream rescoring of the frozen v1 and new v2 dev answer artifacts only; excludes the 104-question test arm

signOff.note: The maintainer approved the recommended D5 fresh-dev qualification, resolution of its remaining operational issues, and provider spend. V7 pins both sides of the cold timeout after v6 exposed the independent 120-second server cap.
